task.goal: What was the longest distance covered in a hiking activity in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single number in meters rounded to the nearest integer.
task.final_summary: The longest hiking distance in OpenTracks this week (Mon 9 Oct to Sun 15 Oct 2023) was 1207 meters. It was the only hiking activity in that window: "Laps around the lake" today (Oct 15, 6:30 AM), 40:00 long, shown as 0.75 mi / 1.21 km, whose pace of 33:08 min/km against 40:00 works out to about 1207 m. The other activities this week were running, sailing, walking, mountain biking, cycling and skateboarding, so none of them counted. I temporarily switched the app's units to metric to read the distance and put them back to Imperial (mi, ft) afterwards.
